text: Das ist die am besten durchdachteste Aufräum/Putzapp für ADHS, die ich ausprobiert habe - und ich habe sehr viele ausprobiert. Super hilfreich ❣️
author: Lou

text: Ich mag die App. Sie motiviert mich tatsächlich dazu zu starten, einige Todos pro Tag abzuhaken und einen Überblick zu behalten. Was noch sehr hilfreich wäre: Wenn man Erledigungen auch rückwirkend abhaken könnte. Ich vergesse oft dann noch alles abzuhaken am selben Tag, was aber dazu führt, dass der Zeitplan durcheinander gerät. Oder ich habe übersehen, dass das bereits möglich ist. // Danke fürs Feedback!
author: Nathalie
developer_reply: Vielen Dank für das tolle Feedback! Es freut uns sehr, dass dich die App motiviert, genau dafür machen wir das. Dein Vorschlag zum nachträglichen Abhaken ist super und steht bereits auf unserer Todo-Liste. Danke für die Hilfe! 🧼✨

text: I love this! When my kids were at school, I had a regular schedule and did things automatically, but since they've become adults & left home, I've been lost & get overwhelmed easily with what needs to be done. I thought I'd try this, and it's amazing! I take a photo, it gives me small steps, and in the end I keep going without needing to look at the app. It's starting that's difficult. I love that you can earn things for your own house in the app too. I have purchased lifetime access! Thank you!
author: Ms Ragnvindr

text: This app is fantastic. I am often so overwhelmed that I paralyze and can't even start. The app let's you take a picture and gives you one step at a time suggestions which is EXACTLY what I need. Bravo! Its truly helping me save my sanity. Very affordable. I never pay for any app a year at a time but this one I'm going to. I'm 68, and ADHD has plagued me my entire life. Thank you so much to the Developers!
author: Solzeye Jewels

text: Honestly one of the few apps that’s actually helped me keep my place under control. I snap a photo, it tells me what to put away, and suddenly a room that felt overwhelming is just a few small tasks. No guilt, no giant checklist. The devs are also super responsive and kind when you reach out. Only wish is that the scan could spot dirt too, not just clutter, but for tidying it’s been a game changer. Five stars.
author: Zuza Hicks
developer_reply: Hi Zuza, thank you so much for your review. It makes us really happy to hear the app is helping out! Jacob & Maya

text: I really like this app. It helped me get in the habit of cleaning my room. sadly the timelapses glitch half the time and you have to manually drag the bar across the bottom. I would be nice if their was a feature where you could press a button to say you did something extra that was not on your checklist like an organizing project and it went into your achievements. overall this is a great app. Note: I have the paid version.
author: Cassandra Rafferty
developer_reply:
FIXED & UPDATED! ✅ Timelapses now save and play smoothly and take up far less space. Please update the app.

You can add custom tasks and rooms/spaces for you to check off if that helps.

text: very helpfull 😀
author: Charlotte Joe

text: After reading the reviews, it appeared as though there was a free version with optional paid upgrades or in-app purchases. But, when I downloaded it, I was immediately asked which version I wanted to pay for. I get that it's a business, but it was still disappointing. I must have missed the info on the app page about there being a required subscription.
author: Keri Jowers
developer_reply:
Hi Keri, thank you for review. There is is a free version. You can close the offer and you will be taken to the home screen of the app.

There is also a 14 day free trial to try premium.

Hope this helps.

text: this is day 1 and I love it! the time and lists are so helpful
author: Jayme Smith
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your review!

text: the best app right now!
author: Cheyenne Garcia
developer_reply: Thanks for your review! Please recommend our app to your friends, and don’t hesitate to shoot us a note at support@adhdcleannig.app if you have any questions.

text: I need a plan to help me declutter as well as clean. I thought the before/after pics would guide the plan to help me. It didn't. Wrong app for me. Sorry.
author: Debra Johnson
developer_reply: ✅ Fixed & Updated: you can now take a picture of your space and the app will give you tiny steps based on your photo!

text: love it so far
author: Shelby Sqaushingroff

text: Update: the free parts of the app are robust. Love the "I'm stuck" button. Software update added some features & unlocked a few; Love the "Energy" level button, I dislike the "decorate your room" it can become a distraction (why I had to stop using Habitica). ~~~~ op ~~~~ not a free app, there is a 7 day trial, after that 4.17 month/49.99 year auto payment if you do the free trial. If you skip the trial it's 9.99 month/89.99 lifetime payment. Will amend in 7 days or so with additional feedback.
author: Melinda Dawn Garren
developer_reply: Hi Melinda, thank you for your review. This is a freemium app. You can use it for free, but some features require premium access. You can try premium 7 days for free. We keep working on improving the app and will release a new update soon. Feel free to contact us at support@adhdcleaning.app if you got any other feedback. Thank you.

text: Een effectief hulpmiddel hoort de gebruiker op mindere dagen te ontlasten. Deze applicatie bereikt echter het tegenovergestelde effect. Door de strikte, schriftelijke registratie van het privéleven neemt de prestatiedruk juist toe, wat contraproductief werkt voor de doelgroep.
author: Marjolein Wilhelmina van Leeuwen
developer_reply:
Dag Marjolein.

Bedankt voor je review. We begrijpen niet precies wat je bedoelt met "schriftelijke registratie van het privéleven"

We proberen wel zo goed mogelijk rekening te houden met de doelgroep. Als je de taken niet afkrijgt die dag, dan is het geen probleem, alles schuift rustig op.

Voor meer feedback: support@adhdcleaning.app
